reading: Capt Smit Machchhar was the pilot of a Flydubai plane.
His co-pilot attacked him in the cockpit during the flight.
Captain Machchhar opened the door to let other people in.
He did not want others to die on the plane.
The plane fell more than 17,000 feet during the attack.
Other passengers helped to stop the attacker.
Two reserve pilots, who were also on the plane, landed it safely.
Many people now praise Captain Machchhar for his courage.

vocabulary.definition: a person who flies an aircraft.
tried to hurt someone with force.
the front part of a plane where the pilot sits and controls it.
different people from the ones already mentioned.
